selectionPolicy.decision: Win-first selection; screen every market and do not force extra picks

picks.analysis: SIRIUS screened the full market board and keeps only Hearts for the new cycle. Hearts enter with the stronger recent profile, including four straight wins and a clear recent H2H advantage over Falkirk. Independent model support reaches 62% for the away win, while available 1X2 prices are around 1.94–2.02, clearing the 1.80 floor. No second pick is forced.
